The direct contract asserts the facade-pin mapping prompt's title, default mapping, parent, accepted mapping, and that the resulting map reaches the merge operation; cancellation before mapping/merge is also tested.
The direct contract asserts the stored-layout anchor prompt's default, parses numeric X,Y coordinates into the merge call, and verifies cancellation prevents file output and merge.
The direct contract asserts the rotation prompt's default, parses counter-clockwise degrees into the merge call, and verifies cancellation prevents file output and merge.
The direct contract asserts the post-merge open-copy confirmation title, consequence, parent, and that only Yes launches the generated PCB copy.
The direct contract exercises mapping prompts for two selected instances, verifies each returned pin map is attached to the matching block placement, and tests cancellation during either instance.
The direct contract exercises per-instance anchor prompts, verifies numeric coordinates are retained in each placement, and tests cancellation before the batch can merge.
The direct contract exercises per-instance rotation prompts, verifies degrees are retained in each placement, and tests cancellation before the batch can merge.
The direct contract asserts the batch open-copy confirmation includes the block count and only launches the generated board when accepted.
